workflow_scale_routing.rationale: One image or compressed visual arc can hold the approved movement without series stewardship.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests sequence, series, long-form expansion, or dependent follow-up parts.

symbology_direction.primary_symbolic_representation: a threshold scene where a still figure, lit doorway, and fragile key carry the grief of return without resolution
symbology_direction.rationale: The threshold scene preserves the central pressure between return and refusal.

style_direction.rationale: Cinematic photoreal grounding keeps the domestic threshold physically real while restrained surreal lighting preserves opacity.

visual_dynamics.target_visual_engine: sparse cinematic threshold composition with active absence and held motion

active_visual_tensions.name: Light / Dark
translation_notes: Use a lit doorway as the bright anchor inside a darker concrete environment.

active_visual_tensions.name: Flat / Deep
translation_notes: Build a clear inside/outside depth axis through the doorway.

minimum_tension_criteria.single_image_requirement: The image must hold at least two visible tensions, with one primary tension at 0.7 or higher, so the viewer feels pressure before reading details.
minimum_tension_criteria.series_requirement: Adjacent series images must shift composition, communication intent, and tension profile rather than repeating the same emotional claim.
minimum_tension_criteria.reviewer_instruction: Block if the image reads as a factual doorway scene without visible contrast between stillness/motion, presence/absence, light/dark, or flat/deep space.

style_visual_conflicts.conflict: Photoreal style could over-literalize the room and reduce the text's opacity.
style_visual_conflicts.adaptation: Use photoreal grounding with restrained surreal lighting and symbolic treatment of the key.

image_roles.composition_intent: Hold the figure at the edge of the lit doorway without resolving entry or departure.
image_roles.communication_intent: Make the audience understand that nearness has become a trap rather than a solution.
image_roles.expectation_turn_translation: The lit doorway appears to promise welcome, but the figure's frozen stance and the key's tiny scale make the light feel dangerous instead of resolving.
image_roles.intended_feeling: the ache of being close to release but unable to choose it

tension_profile.name: Stillness / Motion
translation_notes: The figure is physically still, but the doorway implies imminent motion.

tension_profile.name: Presence / Absence
translation_notes: The lit doorway suggests someone or something missing beyond the frame.

shot_design.composition_strategy: Crop close enough for the key and frozen hand to dominate while the lit doorway remains legible behind the figure.
shot_design.emotional_rationale: A closer frame makes agency feel physically present and painful instead of turning the Beat into a generic full-body doorway pose.
avoid: wide frame that makes the key unreadable

distinction_notes.from_previous_role: opening role; no previous image role
distinction_notes.communication_shift: establishes unresolved nearness as the whole image claim
distinction_notes.tension_shift: holds high stillness/motion pressure without release

series_plan.style_progression: No progression; one compressed threshold beat.

traceability_summary.note: The image plan translates the shared threshold beat into one still composition.
